summary: -i is parsed into iterations; after a warm-up, MPI timing encloses a loop that dispatches the scalar or warp kernel once per iteration for ranks with local rows. RowStart-derived slices are contiguous and span the matrix.

source_evidence.claim: The kernels stride over local rows and CSR entries; rowStart determines rank slices. A warm-up precedes the timed interval, where the selected kernel is launched exactly iterations times.

compiled_evidence.claim: MPI_Wtime brackets the repeated host launch path, whose counter increments and compares to the parsed iteration count while dispatching scalar/warp stubs.

compiled_evidence.claim: Scalar and warp PTX entries show CSR accesses and fma operations in both sparse traversal bodies.

Scalar SASS has CSR loads and DMUL/DADD accumulation, plus a backward BRA at line 235 (0x06b0 to 0x0440); warp SASS has CSR loads/DFMA (lines 420-462) and a backward traversal BRA at line 744 (0x0e70 to 0x08e0).

notes: A rank with no local rows skips its launch; the collective partitions still cover all rows. Warm-up is extra and untimed.
